cues.text: A fifty-seven-year-old man falls off his ladder.
His radiograph shows a midshaft fracture of the humerus.
A midshaft humeral fracture can damage the radial nerve.
That causes wrist drop, because flexion at the wrist is now unopposed.
Sensation is lost over the back of the hand and the lateral three and a half fingers.
It is often called Saturday night palsy. So the damaged nerve is the radial nerve.
